summary: Hardened /tmp and /dev/shm on node1 with persistent tmpfs mounts using nosuid,nodev,noexec. Reboot verification succeeded.
actions_performed: Added persistent /etc/fstab entries for /tmp and /dev/shm with rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,mode=1777.
Confirmed executable files and device nodes are unusable on both mounts.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified a changed boot identity.
Confirmed mounts, configuration, permissions, and required services recovered after reboot.

evidence.summary: Kernel mount records show all three hardening flags; execution and device-node probes fail on both paths.
Persistent fstab entries remain after reboot, recovered mounts retain all flags, and behavioral probes remain denied.

Healthy baseline used boot ID e37a748d-dcbe-43ef-844b-a8884e0548b6; reboot was acknowledged; node returned with boot ID 1436d6b0-be7f-4860-9a37-ce85c9d7af01; required services and hardened mounts recovered.
